context:
Data-first: no threshold is written until w0 shows a stable baseline. The
floor is a relative model derived from observed spread, implemented as an
additive check in the existing nightly assert step, not a rewrite of it.
description:
Promoted from the deferred item in
[[nightly-throughput-gate-restoration]] (surfaced by the UAT-effort
assessment, 2026-07-16). Restoring the nightly throughput gate detects
breakage (a cell fails / stream count wrong) but NOT gradual slowdown: there
is no Throughput@Size floor per platform/scale that a green run must clear.
Without it, a platform can regress in performance run-over-run without the
gate noticing.

This item defines that floor policy. It is deliberately gated on the gate
itself being restored AND on baseline data existing, because the parent's
deferral reason is explicit: "Needs baseline data from several green nightly
runs before a floor is defensible; premature thresholds create flake." A
threshold set before there is a stable baseline manufactures false failures.

anti_patterns.dont: gate on throughput before the gate that produces the baseline (nightly-throughput-gate-restoration) has run green repeatedly.
hardcode an absolute Throughput@Size number from a single run
anti_patterns.why: it will flake on the next runner.

deferrals.reason: Coverage widening is tracked separately (nightly-throughput-gate-restoration defers platform widening on runtime-budget grounds); the floor policy should prove out on the one covered cell first.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] duplicate: Deferral's own reason states coverage widening is tracked in nightly-throughput-gate-restoration, which is open.
deferrals.summary: Extend the floor beyond DuckDB TPC-H SF1

preserves.behavior: The existing stream-count hard gate stays independent — a throughput-floor failure must not mask or replace a stream-count failure.

verifications.description: Floor check present and documented with a data-derived value
verifications.expected: floor check in the nightly assert + documented model/value

work_units.notes:
Confirm nightly-throughput-gate-restoration has landed and that at least
several consecutive green nightly runs exist for DuckDB TPC-H SF1 (the
current single covered cell). Record the observed Throughput@Size spread.
work_units.summary: Re-validate the gap and confirm baseline availability

work_units.notes:
Decision unit. Prefer a relative floor (e.g. fail if Throughput@Size drops
more than X% below a rolling median of the last N green runs) over a
hardcoded absolute number, so the floor tracks hardware/runner drift.
X and N are set from the w0 spread, not guessed. Needs sign-off — a
too-tight floor flakes the gate; a too-loose floor is decorative.
work_units.summary: Choose the threshold model (relative % floor vs absolute floor vs rolling baseline)

work_units.notes:
Add the floor evaluation to the nightly throughput assert (alongside the
existing stream-count hard gate) and document the chosen model + values in
docs/operations/uat-framework.md so the number is not a magic constant.
work_units.summary: Implement the floor check in the nightly assert step and document the policy
